title: audit-log-exporter: wire up audit log export & retention for Private deployments (Helm, Terraform, installer)
author: Maya Chen
description: Motivation: Private customers require automated, auditable export of platform audit logs (RBAC events, API access, operator actions) to customer-managed sinks for compliance. This PR wires the audit-log-exporter into Private deployments end-to-end: Helm chart values, Terraform module outputs, the private-installer render path, default retention/rotation policies, and the upgrade/rollback hooks to ensure log continuity during upgrades. Changes include: - New Helm subchart 'audit-log-exporter' with configurable sinks (s3/gcs/splunk/syslog) and KMS integration points. - Terraform module updates to expose sink credentials/URIs and secrets rotation hooks for private installs. - Private-installer templating: installer now renders the exporter values.yml during bootstrap and validates sink connectivity during post-install. - Retention defaults and a new 'retentionPolicy' Helm value (interaction with object lifecycle rules documented). - RBAC: minimal service account roles scoped to logging namespace; optional clusterRole when requested. - Upgrade path: post-upgrade migration job to rehydrate exporters and resume streaming; pre-upgrade snapshot of exporter checkpoint to avoid duplicate/missing events. - E2E: local kind/integration tests and smoke tests for S3/GCS connectors; unit tests for Terraform helpers. - Docs: internal runbook for operators and a sample Linear ticket template for customer enablement. This description is intentionally continuous. See commits summary and files changed for details. Important notes: - Default retention is 90 days; customers can override via helm values. - Exporters authenticate using customer-managed credentials; for hosted KMS customers we add optional envelope encryption. - We included a dry-run validation in the installer to prevent misconfigured sinks from blocking installs; operator can skip with --force. - Security review completed internally by Priya Nair; no secrets are written to logs. Rollback behavior: exporter state is checkpointed to PVC and migrated where possible; rollback will attempt to resume streaming from last checkpoint. If PVC migration is not available (on certain on-prem storage), operator runbook includes steps to re-seed checkpoint from object store. Related: ENG-4523 (audit automation for private), SUP-1121 (customer request to export audit logs to Splunk).

testing_summary: Local kind cluster + terraform apply against a disposable cloud project was used for validation. Smoke tests covered S3 and GCS sinks. Splunk connector validated via mock Splunk endpoint. Post-merge we will run a staged rollout on the internal private cluster and monitor exporter lag and error_budget metrics.
upgrade_and_rollback_instructions: Upgrade: installer runs pre-upgrade snapshot job to checkpoint exporter state, applies new Helm chart, then runs migration job to rehydrate exporters. Rollback: helm rollback triggers a post-rollback job to attempt checkpoint resume; if PVC cannot be migrated, follow runbook to fetch last checkpoint from object store and re-seed exporter. Runbook path: docs/private/audit-logging-runbook.md
security_considerations: Exporter communicates over TLS for all sinks. Credentials are stored in sealed-secrets by default in Private; Terraform exposes KMS-wrapped secrets for operator use. We explicitly strip secrets from installer logs and CI artifacts. Priya Nair completed security review and added KMS rotation guidance.
release_notes: Private: Add audit-log-exporter subchart and installer wiring; enables streaming audit logs to customer sinks (S3/GCS/Splunk/Syslog)
Default retention set to 90 days; configurable via Helm/TF
Installer validates sink connectivity during install; dry-run available
manual_steps_for_operators: 1) Configure sink credentials in your secrets manager and reference via Terraform outputs. 2) Set retentionPolicy in Helm values or enforce via Terraform. 3) Run private-installer with rendered audit values (default). 4) If upgrading, ensure pre-upgrade snapshot step completes successfully. 5) For rollback edge cases see runbook.
notes: This PR is part of the Private compliance batch for Q1. Follow-up tasks: add Splunk HEC token rotation automation (ENG-4590), add audit replay for incident forensics, and add Prometheus exporter metrics for audit-exporter health.
backwards_compatibility: Retains previous default behavior when the audit-log-exporter is disabled; enabling the chart requires explicit helm value or terraform output. Migration is additive and non-breaking for clusters that don't enable the exporter.
